title: Majority computation initialization
statement: Given natural numbers $a'$ and $k'$ and a Boolean list $z$, encode a state whose first component is the singleton list containing true. Its second component encodes a list of $a' (m+1)^{k'}$ true values, followed by empty-list components and the two lists obtained by decoding $z$ as a pair, where $m$ is the length of the first decoded list.
caveat: The nested pair-encoding and pair-decoding conventions are not included.
